label: Slim strip under the row
thesis: Keep the listing dense: a 42px player, no artwork, opens below the row, and a one-line Listen row on act pages.
risk: Without artwork a visitor can't tell what is playing, and Bandcamp's slim player is its most cramped one.

label: Full player with artwork
thesis: Bandcamp's large player is the draw for small acts: artwork and track list open under the row, and a Listen section with a plum rule on act pages.
risk: A 300px player under a row breaks the dense list's rhythm, and opening several events makes the page very long.

label: Side panel, one player
thesis: The listing never grows: the Bandcamp button fills one sticky panel beside the column, and act pages put play in the lavender strip at the top of the card.
risk: Breaks the one-column rule, needs script to fill the panel, and has no room at narrow widths, where it must become the inline strip anyway.
